gaps.title: Production platform-admin service factory is not composed
gaps.evidence: Admin dependencies fail closed with platform_admin_service_not_composed when app.state.platform_admin_service_factory is absent.
gaps.close_when: The production API composition installs PostgresPlatformAdminServiceFactory with the real session factory and deployment smoke tests pass.

gaps.title: DLQ replay adapter is not composed
gaps.evidence: PlatformAdminService raises ADMIN_DLQ_REPLAY_ADAPTER_NOT_COMPOSED rather than publishing directly.
gaps.close_when: A production DeadLetterReplayPort publishes through the existing inbox/idempotency path and a duplicate replay race proves exactly-once business effect.

gaps.title: Registry release-gate evidence adapter is not composed
gaps.evidence: Production alias promotion raises ADMIN_RELEASE_GATE_EVIDENCE_NOT_COMPOSED and the Admin UI labels the control fail-closed.
gaps.close_when: Agent/Skill/Recipe aliases can only select a persisted version with verified release-gate evidence, with negative and positive integration tests.

gaps.title: Global admin authentication/bootstrap transport is not productized
gaps.evidence: The Admin guard reuses the current organization-scoped browser session as authentication transport before resolving the separate platform_admin_principals record.
gaps.close_when: A dedicated global-admin authentication/bootstrap flow exists without granting access from Organization OWNER and the first SUPER_ADMIN can be provisioned through an audited deployment process.

gaps.title: Organization/User/Project support explorer is not yet implemented
gaps.evidence: NODE-64 core exposes failing run metadata but not full support-search pages.
gaps.close_when: Metadata-only organization, user, and project support pages ship with session revoke/resend invite actions and audits.

gaps.title: Admin audit explorer and incident workflow are not yet implemented
gaps.evidence: Admin audit writes are durable and append-only, but there is no dedicated search/read UI or incident lifecycle in this node implementation.
gaps.close_when: Authorized audit search and incident pages ship without exposing secrets or private content by default.

gaps.title: Organization roles were separated from platform-admin roles
gaps.evidence: PlatformAdminRole is an independent enum and the service factory requires a platform_admin_principals row.

gaps.title: Admin list responses minimize private content
gaps.evidence: SafeRunSummary excludes run input/output and SafeDeadLetter excludes payload_json; frontend runtime parsers only retain safe fields.

gaps.title: Provider and DLQ mutations are permissioned and audited
gaps.evidence: Service permissions distinguish queue.manage, provider.ops and provider.manage; replay, discard and provider overrides append admin audit events.

gaps.title: Feature flags are scoped, expiring and security-policy safe
gaps.evidence: Flags support global/organization/user scope, optional expiry, owner/reason, and security_locked rows cannot be changed by ordinary feature-flag operations.

gaps.title: Break-glass and admin audit records are append-only
gaps.evidence: Database triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE on platform_admin_audit_events and platform_break_glass_grants; break-glass TTL is capped at 30 minutes.
